name: Flip Flop
description: Alternates execution between its A and B outputs each time it is called. The first call goes out A, the next out B, and so on. Also exposes an Is A boolean reporting which path was just taken.

inputs.name: In
inputs.description: Execution pin that triggers the flip-flop. Connect any exec output to advance the internal A/B state.

outputs.name: A
outputs.description: Fires on odd-numbered invocations (first, third, fifth...). Connect the first branch of logic here.

outputs.name: B
outputs.description: Fires on even-numbered invocations (second, fourth, sixth...). Connect the alternate branch of logic here.

outputs.name: Is A
outputs.description: True when the A output just fired (i.e. this was an A call). Useful for branching further off the chosen path.
